faqs.question: What should I do first if I need immediate assistance?
faqs.answer: Please call our 24×7 helpline (+91 84486 61338) or message us on WhatsApp right away. Our team will speak with you politely, understand what you need, and immediately guide you on the next steps while sending the ceremonial vehicle.

faqs.question: Can Eternal Repos help with hospital release documentation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our team helps your family with hospital paperwork, guiding you through doctor death slips, hospital release forms, and gate passes.

faqs.question: Does Eternal Repos issue death certificates?
faqs.answer: Official death certificates are issued by the local municipal office (MCD). We help you fill out forms and gather the right papers so the process is easy and smooth.

faqs.question: Can you arrange transport from a hospital or home?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our clean, air-conditioned vehicle and polite team will arrive at the hospital, nursing home, or residence to safely and respectfully take your loved one to the cremation or burial ground.

faqs.question: Can you help with crematorium or burial-ground formalities?
faqs.answer: Yes. We help book slots, handle gate entry, and guide you through paperwork at crematoriums and shamshan ghats across Delhi NCR so you do not have to worry about administrative desks.

faqs.question: Are prayer halls, flowers and catering available?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can help arrange quiet prayer halls, fresh flower decorations, and simple tea and snacks through trusted local partners.

faqs.question: Do you arrange priests or religious rituals?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can connect you with trusted local pandits or priests so your family traditions and rituals are followed respectfully.

faqs.question: Do you provide grief counselling?
faqs.answer: Yes. We connect families with caring, qualified professional counsellors whenever emotional support is needed, with no extra fees or markups.

faqs.question: Do you support outstation or intercity cases?
faqs.answer: Yes. If you need to take your loved one to your hometown outside Delhi NCR, we arrange dedicated vehicles and help get the necessary travel permits and NOCs.

faqs.question: Can you assist with international repatriation?
faqs.answer: Yes. If your loved one needs to be brought to India from abroad or taken to another country, we coordinate embalming, flight bookings, embassy clearances, and local handling teams.

faqs.question: How quickly can your team arrive?
faqs.answer: Our team is available 24×7 across Delhi NCR. Depending on your location and road traffic, we dispatch the nearest vehicle immediately and keep you updated on the exact arrival time.
